cohort: The study included 82 neonates admitted to Tesseney Hospital in Eritrea between January 1, 2020, and December 31, 2020.
finding: Preterm delivery, home delivery, and low-birth weight were significantly associated with increased neonatal mortality, and the hottest months of the year correlated with higher neonatal admission rates and mortality.
mod_finding: Home delivery had a significant association with neonatal mortality.
birth_weight: A majority (51%) of neonates had low birth weight, and birth weight above 2.5 kg was significantly associated with neonatal survival.
gest_age: 71% of neonates were delivered at term, and preterm delivery was significantly associated with neonatal mortality.
